svg.title: nabd | Measure
svg.desc: nabd: an open network of GPS-synchronized ESP32-S3 nodes that measure grid frequency, ROCOF and voltage synchrophasors (IEEE C37.118). Nabd means pulse in Arabic. Animated illustration: every node pulses on the same GPS second and its phasor turns against the same reference. Click to open the repository.

g.text: GPS-synced sensors on the grid’s pulse.
SAME GPS SECOND · SAME PHASE REFERENCE · EVERY NODE
